Your Choice

There are two ways
to become part of AnnaSetu.

You can give something useful. Or you can give your time, vehicle and effort. Both are Seva.

Donate

Have extra food after a wedding, birthday, family gathering or community event? Have clothes, ration, blankets or other useful items? Post them on AnnaSetu.

Start Donating

Serve

Want to help someone directly? Find nearby donation opportunities, contact the donor, travel to the location, collect the donation and help distribute it.

Our Community Partner

Maitri Foundation

Local care. Real people. Meaningful Seva.

Established in 2021, Maitri Foundation works in Pune to support people in local communities through care, essential-item distribution and volunteer-led initiatives. AnnaSetu shares that same spirit: bringing people who can give together with people ready to serve.

Pune, Maharashtra Established 2021
Join Us on Instagram Follow @maitri.foundation_07 and be part of the next Seva drive.

OUR PURPOSE

AnnaSetu aims to reduce food waste and help surplus food and useful essentials reach people who need them most. One shared post can help someone find a meal. Together, we can turn waste into care.

Proposed, Created & Developed by Vibhav Kumar Maurya
